SUM(shuang_yue_qi_ta) AS "shuangYueQiTa", -- 爽约-其他 SUM(shuang_yue_age_0_14) AS "shuangYueAge0_14", -- 爽约-0至14岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_15_19) AS "shuangYueAge15_19", -- 爽约-15至19岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_20_29) AS "shuangYueAge20_29", -- 爽约-20至29岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_30_39) AS "shuangYueAge30_39", -- 爽约-30至39岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_40_49) AS "shuangYueAge40_49", -- 爽约-40至49岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_50_59) AS "shuangYueAge50_59", -- 爽约-50至59岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_60_69) AS "shuangYueAge60_69", -- 爽约-60至69岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_70_79) AS "shuangYueAge70_79", -- 爽约-70至79岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_80_89) AS "shuangYueAge80_89", -- 爽约-80至89岁 SUM(shuang_yue_age_90_up) AS "shuangYueAge90Up" -- 爽约-90岁及以上 FROM ( -- A. 就诊日扫描: 总挂号 + 爽约情况二(预约0/已取号未就诊1, 按日×科室×身份证去重) SELECT TRUNC(c.stat_date) AS stat_day, -- 统计日期 c.dept_code, -- 科室编码 COUNT(1) AS total_guahao, -- 总挂号量 0 AS tui_hao_shu, -- 退号数(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_zi_zhu_ji, 0 AS tui_hao_chuang_kou, -- 退号-自助机/窗口(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_chong_qing, 0 AS tui_hao_si_chuan, 0 AS tui_hao_gui_zhou, -- 退号-重庆/四川/贵州(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_yun_nan, 0 AS tui_hao_qi_ta, -- 退号-云南/其他(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_0_14, 0 AS tui_hao_age_15_19, 0 AS tui_hao_age_20_29, -- 退号-0至14/15至19/20至29岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_30_39, 0 AS tui_hao_age_40_49, 0 AS tui_hao_age_50_59, -- 退号-30至39/40至49/50至59岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_60_69, 0 AS tui_hao_age_70_79, 0 AS tui_hao_age_80_89, -- 退号-60至69/70至79/80至89岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_90_up, -- 退号-90岁及以上(占位) COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_shu, -- 爽约数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND (SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '50' OR SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 4) = '5122') THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_chong_qing, -- 爽约-重庆 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND (SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '51' AND SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 4) != '5122') THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_si_chuan, -- 爽约-四川 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '52' THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_gui_zhou, -- 爽约-贵州 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '53' THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_yun_nan, -- 爽约-云南 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND (SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) NOT IN ('50','51','52','53') OR c.id_no IS NULL) THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_qi_ta, -- 爽约-其他 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) < 15 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_0_14, -- 爽约-0至14岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_15_19, -- 爽约-15至19岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_20_29, -- 爽约-20至29岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_30_39, -- 爽约-30至39岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_40_49, -- 爽约-40至49岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_50_59, -- 爽约-50至59岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_60_69, -- 爽约-60至69岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_70_79, -- 爽约-70至79岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_80_89, -- 爽约-80至89岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.registration_status <= 1 AND LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) >= 90 THEN NVL(c.id_no, 'V' || c.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_90_up -- 爽约-90岁及以上 FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRUNC(c.stat_date), c.dept_code UNION ALL -- B. 退号日扫描: 退号全维度(数/渠道/属地/年龄, 归期=returned_date) SELECT TRUNC(c.returned_date) AS stat_day, -- 统计日期(退号日) c.dept_code, -- 科室编码 0 AS total_guahao, -- 总挂号量(占位) COUNT(1) AS tui_hao_shu, -- 退号数 SUM(CASE WHEN c.returned_operator = '自助机' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_zi_zhu_ji, -- 退号-自助机 SUM(CASE WHEN c.returned_operator != '自助机' OR c.returned_operator IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_chuang_kou, -- 退号-窗口 SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '50' OR SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 4) = '5122' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_chong_qing, -- 退号-重庆 SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '51' AND SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 4) != '5122' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_si_chuan, -- 退号-四川 SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_gui_zhou, -- 退号-贵州 SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) = '53' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_yun_nan, -- 退号-云南 SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(c.id_no, 1, 2) NOT IN ('50','51','52','53') OR c.id_no IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_qi_ta, -- 退号-其他 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) < 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_0_14, -- 退号-0至14岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_15_19, -- 退号-15至19岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_20_29, -- 退号-20至29岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_30_39, -- 退号-30至39岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_40_49, -- 退号-40至49岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_50_59, -- 退号-50至59岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_60_69, -- 退号-60至69岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_70_79, -- 退号-70至79岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_80_89, -- 退号-80至89岁 SUM(CASE WHEN LENGTH(c.id_no) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.returned_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(c.id_no, 7, 4))) >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tui_hao_age_90_up, -- 退号-90岁及以上 0 AS shuang_yue_shu, -- 爽约数(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_chong_qing, 0 AS shuang_yue_si_chuan, 0 AS shuang_yue_gui_zhou, -- 爽约-重庆/四川/贵州(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_yun_nan, 0 AS shuang_yue_qi_ta, -- 爽约-云南/其他(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_age_0_14, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_15_19, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_20_29, -- 爽约-0至14/15至19/20至29岁(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_age_30_39, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_40_49, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_50_59, -- 爽约-30至39/40至49/50至59岁(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_age_60_69, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_70_79, 0 AS shuang_yue_age_80_89, -- 爽约-60至69/70至79/80至89岁(占位) 0 AS shuang_yue_age_90_up -- 爽约-90岁及以上(占位) FROM TR_OUTP_FIN_CLINIC_MASTER c WHERE c.returned_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY TRUNC(c.returned_date), c.dept_code UNION ALL -- C. 爽约情况一: 预约了未到诊(queue当日预约行关联不上挂号记录), 科室NULL只进合计 SELECT TRUNC(q.stat_date) AS stat_day, -- 统计日期 CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(100)) AS dept_code, -- 科室编码(空,只进合计) 0 AS total_guahao, -- 总挂号量(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_shu, -- 退号数(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_zi_zhu_ji, 0 AS tui_hao_chuang_kou, -- 退号-自助机/窗口(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_chong_qing, 0 AS tui_hao_si_chuan, 0 AS tui_hao_gui_zhou, -- 退号-重庆/四川/贵州(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_yun_nan, 0 AS tui_hao_qi_ta, -- 退号-云南/其他(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_0_14, 0 AS tui_hao_age_15_19, 0 AS tui_hao_age_20_29, -- 退号-0至14/15至19/20至29岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_30_39, 0 AS tui_hao_age_40_49, 0 AS tui_hao_age_50_59, -- 退号-30至39/40至49/50至59岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_60_69, 0 AS tui_hao_age_70_79, 0 AS tui_hao_age_80_89, -- 退号-60至69/70至79/80至89岁(占位) 0 AS tui_hao_age_90_up, -- 退号-90岁及以上(占位) COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no)) AS shuang_yue_shu, -- 爽约数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 1, 2) = '50' OR SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 1, 4) = '5122' THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS WHEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 1, 2) = '53' THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_yun_nan, -- 爽约-云南 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 1, 2) NOT IN ('50','51','52','53') OR q.id_no IS NULL THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_qi_ta, -- 爽约-其他 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(q.id_no)) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) < 15 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_0_14, -- 爽约-0至14岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(q.id_no)) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) BETWEEN 15 AND 19 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_15_19, -- 爽约-15至19岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(q.id_no)) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_30_39, -- 爽约-30至39岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(q.id_no)) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_50_59, -- 爽约-50至59岁 TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) BETWEEN 80 AND 89 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_80_89, -- 爽约-80至89岁 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LENGTH(TO_CHAR(q.id_no)) >= 15 AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM q.stat_date) - TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 7, 4))) >= 90 THEN NVL(TO_CHAR(q.id_no), 'Q' || q.visit_no) END) AS shuang_yue_age_90_up -- 爽约-90岁及以上 FROM #{endDate} AND cm.patient_id IS NULL GROUP BY TRUNC(q.stat_date) ) GROUP BY stat_day, dept_code ORDER BY stat_day, dept_code
SELECT dept_code AS "deptCode", dept_name AS "deptName" FROM TR_DEPT_DICT -- 科室编码/科室名称
